scenarios.name: Open Join as a Client registration page
scenarios.criteria: Clicking Join Healing Sky in the main navigation and selecting Join as a Client navigates to the client registration page.
preconditions: Healing Sky homepage must be loaded.

scenarios.name: Complete client registration form one field at a time
scenarios.criteria: Completing the client registration form one field at a time sets the Full Name, Email, Phone Number, Date of Birth, Address Lookup, and Referral Code fields correctly in sequence without placeholder text remaining.
scenarios.endState: Client registration form is filled but not submitted.

scenarios.name: Check and submit completed client registration form
scenarios.criteria: Submitting the completed client registration form succeeds when all fields are correctly set, and the application either displays 'Registration completed successfully' or navigates to the client login page (/client/login).
preconditions: Client registration form is filled but not submitted.
scenarios.startState: Client registration form is filled but not submitted.
scenarios.endState: Client registration succeeds with a success message or navigation to the client login page.

scenarios.name: Navigate to client sign-in page and log in with email
scenarios.criteria: Navigating to the client sign-in page, selecting Email as the OTP delivery method, entering the configured client email, and clicking Log in opens the OTP verification screen.
preconditions: Healing Sky homepage must be loaded.
scenarios.endState: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.

scenarios.name: Submit OTP and verify sign-in success
scenarios.criteria: Entering the configured OTP into the OTP fields and clicking Verify displays 'OTP verified successfully' and navigates to the authenticated client dashboard (/client/dashboard).
preconditions: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.
scenarios.startState: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.

scenarios.name: Log out from authenticated client dashboard
scenarios.criteria: Logging out from the authenticated client dashboard returns the client to the Healing Sky homepage with the Log in option visible again.
scenarios.endState: Healing Sky homepage is displayed with the Log in option visible.
